name: Class Pack
author: Gabriel
description: Extra mischief: a swim class in a pool hall and a dance class in a disco hall, picked on an elevator panel; a wardrobe with hats, outfits, hairstyles, face and body sliders; bots dressed like the players; three new teachers; nerf guns that knock people out cold; phones you find in your desk, with DoorDash, prank calls and a bag of tricks (paper airplane, water balloon, super glue, laser pointer, whoopee cushion, notes, naps); students hung out of the windows; a fire alarm, a teacher who eats your snacks, and power cuts in the middle of class.
